I prefer Option B as the collection of actions grows, but I’d keep the read-status button visible beside Edit because I’ll use it often. Less frequent actions such as Archive and Delete can live under More.

Opening the original in a new tab, keeping the existing details when I edit the address, and always confirming permanent deletion all behave as I’d want. If I change the address to one that is already saved, it should also prevent a duplicate and guide me to the existing bookmark.
